title: Apparel returns
text: Apparel items can be returned within 7 days of delivery. Items must be unused, unwashed, and have original tags attached.

title: Footwear returns
text: Footwear can be returned within 7 days of delivery. The product must be unworn and returned with its original packaging.

title: Electronics returns
text: Electronics can be returned within 10 days of delivery for eligible defects or damage. Serial numbers and accessories must match the order.

title: Home returns
text: Eligible home products can be returned within 10 days of delivery. Products must be unused and packed securely.

title: Beauty returns
text: Beauty products can be returned within 7 days only when unopened or damaged on arrival. Opened hygiene products are not eligible.

title: COD refunds
text: Approved COD refunds are processed to the customer's verified bank account or wallet. Refunds usually arrive within 5 to 7 business days after approval.

title: Prepaid refunds
text: Approved prepaid-order refunds are sent to the original payment method. Banks or payment providers may require 3 to 5 business days.

title: Standard delivery SLA
text: Standard delivery generally takes 3 to 7 business days after order confirmation. The estimated date shown at checkout is the applicable commitment.

title: Delayed delivery
text: If an order passes its estimated delivery date, customers can track the latest status in the order page. Support may investigate prolonged delays.

title: Reverse pickup eligibility
text: Reverse pickup is available for eligible pin codes and products. The item must be packed according to the return instructions.

title: Reverse pickup attempts
text: The courier may make multiple pickup attempts when the customer is unavailable. Customers should keep the package ready with labels attached.

title: Non-returnable products
text: Personalized products, opened hygiene items, and products marked non-returnable on the listing cannot normally be returned. Damaged-on-arrival cases may be reviewed separately.
